sources.name: List of countries with multiple capitals - Wiki

_: Jakarta - De facto administrative capital | Nusantara - Official capital
Bloemfontein - Judicial capital | Cape Town - Legislative capital (parliament) | Pretoria - Administrative and executive capital
Kabul - Administrative, cultural and financial capital | Kandahar - De facto capital, founding city of the Taliban and the seat of the Taliban Parliament, and the Supreme Leader
Kuala Lumpur - Legislative (parliament), seat of the Yang di-Pertuan Agong and constitutional capital | Putrajaya - Administrative centre; variously referred to as the administrative capital
Abidjan - De facto administrative capital | Yamoussoukro - Official capital
Colombo - Executive and judicial capital | Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte - Legislative capital (parliament)
Amsterdam - Official capital | The Hague - Legislative capital (parliament)
Cotonou -- De facto administrative capital | Porto-Novo - Official capital
Bujumbura - Seat of government and economic capital | Gitega - Official political capital
La Paz - De facto executive capital | Sucre - Constitutional capital
Lobamba - Legislative (parliament) and royal capital | Mbabane - Administrative capital
